subject: Highland Financial - Security capability matrix & SIG intake
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura@highlandfinancial.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@highlandfinancial.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Highland - SIG / SOC2 / ISO intake and capability matrix

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor intake we need to capture a capability matrix and the SIG questionnaire (we started with the STANDARD SIG) so we can complete our Security and Procurement review. Can your team: 

- Confirm which SOC 2 report(s) you have (Type II, date range) and provide a redact-friendly PDF.
- Provide a completed capability matrix mapping your controls to SIG v2.1 and ISO 27001 controls where applicable.
- Share representative artifacts: sample audit logs (redacted), KMS architecture diagram, and any evidence for change management and access reviews.

Attached is our intake template (Highland_SIG_Template_v3.xlsx) — please fill the control mapping tabs and return by end of next week (EOD Apr 18) if possible.

Two clarifying notes: we are onboarding Redwood for both hosted API and a future dedicated pool; please call out any differences in control posture between those modes.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and an approximate delivery plan.

Best,
Laura Simmons
Head of Vendor Security
Highland Financial

Attachment: Highland_SIG_Template_v3.xlsx

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura@highlandfinancial.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@highlandfinancial.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Highland - SIG / SOC2 / ISO intake and capability matrix

Hi Laura — thanks for the template and the clear asks. Confirming we can run the mapping and assemble the artifacts you requested. Quick summary of what we will provide and an initial timeline: 

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (coverage: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). We will provide a redact-friendly summary now and the full report under NDA if required. Attachment: RI_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf.
- Control mapping: we will populate Highland_SIG_Template_v3.xlsx and add an ISO crosswalk for the scopes you listed. Attachment: RI-control-map-highland-v1.xlsx.
- Artifacts: sample audit log extracts (redacted), KMS diagram, and a short change-management evidence packet. We will surface specific file names in the mapping where appropriate.

Proposed milestones: 
1) Wed Apr 14 — initial control mapping (draft)
2) Fri Apr 16 — artifacts drop (redacted samples) via shared Drive link
3) Mon Apr 19 — final updates based on your follow-ups

A couple of clarifying questions before we start: 
- Scope: confirm if Highland requires evidence for private (on-prem) deployments as well or only hosted/dedicated cloud instances for the pilot.
- Do you need raw log snippets or formatted CSV exports for ingestion into your tooling?

I’ve shared a working folder on Drive and uploaded the initial mapping draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHighlandIntake.

Ben, assigning you to lead the artifact collection and redaction. I’ll coordinate the matrix entries and client communications.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI-control-map-highland-v1.xlsx, RI_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Simmons <laura@highlandfinancial.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Highland - SIG / SOC2 / ISO intake and capability matrix

Sofia / Laura — looping in details from the security ops side. 

What we can provide immediately (redacted copies or sanitized extracts):
- Audit log extracts (application and infra) — typical CSV export, 7 days of sample activity attached (audit-logs-sample.txt).
- KMS architecture diagram and key rotation policy snippets (kms-diagram.png).
- Change management: ticket templates, evidence of quarterly change windows and approvals (we will point to specific Jira keys in the mapping).
- Identity and access: list of groups and privilege tiers (we can provide screenshots and an access review report for the last 90 days).

Notes on scope and caveats: 
- Dedicated capacity: operationally the runtime uses customer-isolated GPU pools; the control implementation is the same but some deployment-specific network controls come into play (we will flag those rows in the mapping).
- ISO scope: we have an ISO 27001-aligned program but are not currently certified; we will map controls but mark certification status accordingly.

I’ve attached internal mapping notes and a short checklist for items that will need customer confirmation (S3 cross-account logging, egress requirements, long-term retention needs).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: audit-logs-sample.txt, kms-diagram.png, RI-control-mapping-notes.txt

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Simmons <laura@highlandfinancial.com>, Procurement <procurement@highlandfinancial.com>, Legal <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Highland - SIG / SOC2 / ISO intake and capability matrix

Thanks team — appreciate the rapid turnaround. Quick coordination note and next steps: 

- Confirmed timeline: draft mapping Wed Apr 14; artifacts posted to Drive Fri Apr 16. If Highland needs accelerated delivery, we can prioritize the SOC2 report and KMS artifacts for an earlier handoff.
- Action items assigned: 
  * Ben — finalize redacted audit log exports and KMS diagram (by Apr 15).
  * Sofia — complete control mapping draft and ISO crosswalk (by EOD Apr 14).
  * Legal — prepared to execute an NDA/SSC if Highland needs the full SOC2 PDF (CCed).
  * Procurement (Highland) — confirm whether you want evidence for the private deployment stream as well.

I’ve created HubSpot deal HLND-2027-42 and added internal tasks; kickoff call scheduled here: https://calendly.com/redwood-compliance/kickoff-highland — please pick a slot if the proposed windows work.

Sofia/Ben — let’s do a 30-minute prep at 11:00am Wed to review the draft mapping before we share.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
